coveredSubmeaning.meaning: The exact existing compiler capability and MEDIA-REQ-CAP-RECIPE-TEMPLATE-AC-07 support typed semantic compilation, schema/source/compiler-contract provenance, deterministic normalized graph/fingerprint, and invalid/unauthorized no-effect behavior.

completeSourceFeature.reason: The source feature also names production-schema migrations; current PDP-0 text defines versioned schema bindings and compatibility invalidation but does not define the product outcome for schema migration. The candidate correctly marks this as an unresolved PDP-0 definition item; it must not be considered full AUD-SPEC-002 coverage.

assessment.pxdMechanicsBoundary: PDP-1 may own migration mechanics after PDP-0 defines intended migration outcomes and compatibility behavior.

findings.issue: The proposed row has disposition PDP0_MEANING_CHANGE_REQUIRED, while the same postimage retains dispositionCounts.PDP0_MEANING_CHANGE_REQUIRED=0, BOUND_EXISTING=499, and unresolvedPdp0Ids without AUD-SPEC-002. The parent decision note still states 499 BOUND_EXISTING and 2 implementation-only rows.
findings.correction: Recompute and validate all disposition counters and unresolved-ID projections for the proposed 501-row postimage, while retaining the historical PXD-207 decision as predecessor evidence and adding the new exact owner decision separately.
findings.acceptance: The full 501-row inventory is unique and exact; counts equal row dispositions; AUD-SPEC-002 is represented as a PDP-0 meaning gap; deterministic plan --check and a regression test reject projection drift.

findings.issue: The candidate correctly says PDP-0 migration product meaning is undefined and PDP-1 owns mechanics, but preservedBoundaries names the PDP-1 handoff migrationSemantics. That label can imply PDP-1 owns missing semantics.
findings.correction: Rename the boundary to migrationMechanics or equivalent and keep the PDP-0 meaning gap explicitly unresolved.
findings.acceptance: Candidate/schema distinguish the unresolved PDP-0 user outcome from PDP-1 mechanics; no phrase assigns missing product intent to PDP-1.

findings.issue: A supplied source-owner decision is accepted when ownerIdentity is any string and sourceBindings/hashes match; the candidate does not bind that identity to the delegated root technical source owner or an exact PXD decision section. The peer is also only a distinct identity string plus hash fields.
findings.correction: Before recording the candidate as source-owner/peer reviewed, require the authorized root identity and a source-bound decision reference/fingerprint, plus a distinct peer review record reference/fingerprint that binds this exact postimage. Do not label an AI peer record as independent human acceptance.
findings.acceptance: Tests reject arbitrary owner identities, missing/duplicate/stale PXD section bindings, self-review and peer records that do not hash-bind the exact postimage.
